_doc: Replacement table for tools/apply_terms.py (glossary gap pass of 2026-10-27, reports/_glossary_gaps.md). Applied in order, per unit, only where the unit's Japanese contains jp / jp_re. See the script docstring for the fields. The glossary forms are in terms.json / characters.json; this file only lists the wrong renderings found in the corpus.

User decision 14A: 'Master' until he becomes head. He refuses in R_19 (U05157-U05205, U05353 'give him time'); the succession is told only in the R_20 narration U05409, so every 輝元様 up to U05353 is 'Master', from U05415 on 'Lord'.
User decision 15A: 'Master' for an heir not yet head and for teachers. Young Shikanosuke at home in Izumo (Shino speaking); later scenes (U04606 on) keep 'Lord Shikanosuke'.
